purpose: Bounded decoder and KL follow-up; no detector adoption or gate tuning
control_policy: Fresh realizations, same generative case families; truth accessible only after prediction freeze
measurement_policy: Previously viewed TTMAPP; developmental evaluation, not independent STM validation
gate_policy: Copy issue21 transfer calibration exactly, no new thresholds or baseline feature-adapter fitting

rotation_diagnostic.expected_latent_delta_degrees: -90 * k for the decoder row-vector convention
rotation_diagnostic.selection: Evenly spaced indices of available patches in sorted window-ID order
rotation_diagnostic.support: Identical complete patch; no padding, cropping or interpolation
rotation_diagnostic.symmetry_policy: Additional residual modulo lattice symmetry only when derived from known synthetic basis; no assumed M6 or real-image symmetry
rotation_diagnostic.limitation: Quarter turns modulo square-lattice symmetry are uninformative alone; retain nontrivial 27degree and 8degree two-domain controls
